contract: One Unit's input-before-transition recording, committed-result recovery, FIFO completed-input identity retention and zero-or-one committed outbox offers through the ready Store, Writer, Checkpoint and Outbox boundaries.
limits: Finite DU1–DU8 scenarios, not universal recovery or exactly-once proofs; no new Cure law for the shell.
Input-identity retention does not bound log/witness memory or recovery time; no pruning or checkpoint witness truncation. Evicted IDs may apply again.
Mailbox delivery is volatile and unacknowledged; only synchronous applied/duplicate replies establish committed results. Caller owns resubmission and reconciliation after uncertainty.
Persistence inherits the Store; Memory demonstrates process restart, not disk durability. Destination dispatch, idempotency, acknowledgement and availability are external.

Trusted deterministic serializable plain BEAM data, excluding processes, references, funs, resources and secrets; caller owns data compatibility. Stream configuration and v1 format interpretation are fixed for its lifetime.
No retry scheduler, poison skip, migration, follower promotion, pause/drain/resume or automatic restart loop on named shutdown reasons.

grounding.claim: Named DU1–DU8 scenarios: both intakes/validation, crashes before input and before/after result, unresolved restarts, offers/ack/64-item passes, checkpoint fault reconciliation/version/pruning/size, FIFO retention, both conflict stages, poison/format/storage uncertainty and transient shutdown; finite Memory scenarios, not disk durability or universal proofs.
Pinned Elixir GenServer calls, registration and transient child specifications; call timeout/exit without reply is uncertain.
OTP 29.1.2 links, monitors, SHA-256, deterministic external-term encoding and safe decoding are upstream contracts, not local proofs.

Caller supplies supervision, exclusively matching Store/fold/limits/stream configuration, a pure deterministic terminating operator, trusted serializable application data, prompt nonblocking offer callback and dispatcher commit/ack policy. Ready Store CAS, Writer, Checkpoint and Outbox contracts supply persistence boundaries.

telemetry.contract: No telemetry events or input/state/output payload logging supplied.

config.contract: Required store, stream, operator, retention_count, max_record_bytes, max_checkpoint_bytes and offer fixed at start; optional ordinary OTP name; positive integer inclusive byte limits, FIFO completed-input count; no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: checkpoint returns ready Checkpoint.take/4 result unchanged (indeterminate stops); offer_pending returns {:ok, offered_count} or {:error, :offer_unavailable}, at most 64 offers per pass. Ordinary OTP lifecycle; no pause/drain/resume.
